```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# -----------------------------
# Load inputs
# -----------------------------
df_freq <- readRDS(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/motif_analysis_no_annot/endmotif_4bp_freq_per_sample_ATGC_only.rds"
)

meta_single <- read_csv(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_site_summary/metastasis_single_site_combinations.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# -----------------------------
# Extract unique IDs
# -----------------------------
ids_freq <- sort(unique(df_freq$id))
ids_meta <- sort(unique(meta_single$id))

# -----------------------------
# Check overlaps
# -----------------------------
common_ids <- intersect(ids_freq, ids_meta)
only_in_freq <- setdiff(ids_freq, ids_meta)
only_in_meta <- setdiff(ids_meta, ids_freq)

# -----------------------------
# Report
# -----------------------------
cat("Total samples in motif data:      ", length(ids_freq), "\n")
cat("Total samples in metastasis meta: ", length(ids_meta), "\n")
cat("Common samples:                   ", length(common_ids), "\n\n")

cat("Samples only in motif data (missing in metastasis):\n")
if (length(only_in_freq) == 0) {
  cat("  NONE\n")
} else {
  print(only_in_freq)
}

cat("\nSamples only in metastasis meta (missing in motif data):\n")
if (length(only_in_meta) == 0) {
  cat("  NONE\n")
} else {
  print(only_in_meta)
}

```

```{r}
# liver, brain and bone represent ~70% of single-site cohort and biologically distinct tissues

top_sites <- c("liver", "brain", "bone")

df_site_top <- df_freq %>%
inner_join(
meta_single %>% mutate(
id = str_trim(id),
metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites))
),
by = "id"
) %>%
mutate(metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites))) %>%
filter(metastatic_sites %in% top_sites)

df_site_top %>%
distinct(id, metastatic_sites) %>%
count(metastatic_sites)

```
```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# ATGC-only motif analysis (PRIMARY)

# ------------------------------------------------------------

# - Uses ONLY single-site samples

# - Restricts to top sites: liver, brain, bone

# - Restricts motifs to canonical ATGC-only (no IUPAC codes)

# - Separates:

# (A) site-exclusive motifs (present in only 1 site group)  -> NO inferential stats

# (B) differential/testable motifs (present in >=2 sites)   -> KW + FDR + effect size

# ------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(rstatix)
})

# -----------------------------

# Paths

# -----------------------------

freq_rds <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/motif_analysis_no_annot/endmotif_4bp_freq_per_sample_ATGC_only.rds"
meta_single_csv <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_site_summary/metastasis_single_site_combinations.csv"

outdir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_motif_results_single_site_top3/ATGC_only"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# -----------------------------

# Parameters

# -----------------------------

top_sites <- c("liver", "brain", "bone")
require_all_three_sites <- FALSE

# Recommended for discovery; change if you want

fdr_cutoff <- 0.10

# -----------------------------

# Load data

# -----------------------------

df_freq <- readRDS(freq_rds)

meta_single <- read_csv(meta_single_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
mutate(
id = str_trim(id),
metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites))
)

# Merge + restrict to top sites

df_site_top <- df_freq %>%
inner_join(meta_single, by = "id") %>%
mutate(metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites))) %>%
filter(metastatic_sites %in% top_sites)

# -----------------------------

# IMPORTANT: keep ONLY ATGC motifs

# -----------------------------

df_site_top <- df_site_top %>%
mutate(end_motif = toupper(end_motif)) %>%
filter(!grepl("[^ATGC]", end_motif))

# Confirm cohort sizes

site_n <- df_site_top %>%
distinct(id, metastatic_sites) %>%
count(metastatic_sites, sort = TRUE)

message("Single-site cohort sizes (top sites only):")
print(site_n)

message("Unique motifs after ATGC filter: ", n_distinct(df_site_top$end_motif))

```
```{r}
# -----------------------------

# Motif presence across site groups

# -----------------------------

motif_presence <- df_site_top %>%
group_by(end_motif, metastatic_sites) %>%
summarise(
any_present = any(is.finite(freq.corrected) & freq.corrected > 0),
.groups = "drop"
) %>%
group_by(end_motif) %>%
summarise(
n_sites_present = sum(any_present),
present_sites = paste(metastatic_sites[any_present], collapse = ","),
.groups = "drop"
)

site_exclusive <- motif_presence %>%
filter(n_sites_present == 1)

testable <- motif_presence %>%
filter(n_sites_present >= 2)

if (require_all_three_sites) {
testable <- motif_presence %>%
filter(n_sites_present == length(top_sites))
}

message("Motifs total (ATGC-only): ", n_distinct(df_site_top$end_motif))
message("Site-exclusive motifs (present in exactly 1 top site): ", nrow(site_exclusive))
message("Testable motifs (present in >=2 sites): ", nrow(testable),
if (require_all_three_sites) " [REQUIRING all 3 sites]" else "")

```
```{r}
# Save motif presence tables

write_csv(motif_presence, file.path(outdir, "motif_presence_top_sites_ATGC.csv"))
write_csv(site_exclusive, file.path(outdir, "motif_site_exclusive_top_sites_ATGC.csv"))
write_csv(testable, file.path(outdir, "motif_testable_top_sites_ATGC.csv"))

# -----------------------------

# Prepare testable dataset

# -----------------------------

df_testable <- df_site_top %>%
filter(end_motif %in% testable$end_motif) %>%
filter(is.finite(freq.corrected))

# -----------------------------

# Global test: Kruskalâ€“Wallis per motif

# -----------------------------

res_kw <- df_testable %>%
group_by(end_motif) %>%
filter(n_distinct(metastatic_sites) >= 2) %>%
group_modify(~ kruskal_test(.x, freq.corrected ~ metastatic_sites)) %>%
ungroup() %>%
adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
arrange(p.adj, p)

# -----------------------------

# Effect size per motif

# -----------------------------

res_eff <- df_testable %>%
group_by(end_motif) %>%
filter(n_distinct(metastatic_sites) >= 2) %>%
group_modify(~ kruskal_effsize(.x, freq.corrected ~ metastatic_sites)) %>%
ungroup()

# Combine

res_final <- res_kw %>%
left_join(res_eff, by = "end_motif") %>%
arrange(p.adj, p)

# Save primary results

write_csv(res_final, file.path(outdir, "res_4bp_kw_top_sites_ATGC.csv"))
saveRDS(res_final, file.path(outdir, "res_4bp_kw_top_sites_ATGC.rds"))

message("Tested motifs (KW): ", nrow(res_final))
message("Significant motifs (FDR < ", fdr_cutoff, "): ",
sum(res_final$p.adj < fdr_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE))

```
```{r}
# -----------------------------

# Optional: Post-hoc pairwise Wilcoxon for significant motifs

# -----------------------------

sig_motifs <- res_final %>%
filter(p.adj < fdr_cutoff) %>%
pull(end_motif)

if (length(sig_motifs) > 0) {
res_pairwise <- df_testable %>%
filter(end_motif %in% sig_motifs) %>%
group_by(end_motif) %>%
wilcox_test(freq.corrected ~ metastatic_sites) %>%
adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
arrange(p.adj, p) %>%
ungroup()

write_csv(res_pairwise, file.path(outdir, "res_4bp_pairwise_wilcox_top_sites_ATGC.csv"))
saveRDS(res_pairwise, file.path(outdir, "res_4bp_pairwise_wilcox_top_sites_ATGC.rds"))

message("Pairwise Wilcoxon results written for ", length(sig_motifs), " significant motifs.")
} else {
message("No significant motifs at FDR < ", fdr_cutoff, "; skipping pairwise Wilcoxon.")
}

```
```{r}
# -----------------------------

# Site-exclusive motifs: descriptive output (no inferential stats)

# -----------------------------

exclusive_summary <- df_site_top %>%
filter(end_motif %in% site_exclusive$end_motif) %>%
group_by(end_motif, metastatic_sites) %>%
summarise(
n = n(),
median_freq = median(freq.corrected, na.rm = TRUE),
mean_freq = mean(freq.corrected, na.rm = TRUE),
.groups = "drop"
) %>%
left_join(site_exclusive, by = "end_motif") %>%
arrange(desc(median_freq))

write_csv(exclusive_summary, file.path(outdir, "site_exclusive_motifs_descriptive_top_sites_ATGC.csv"))
saveRDS(exclusive_summary, file.path(outdir, "site_exclusive_motifs_descriptive_top_sites_ATGC.rds"))

```

```{r}
# write run summary text

summary_txt <- file.path(outdir, "RUN_SUMMARY_ATGC.txt")

writeLines(c(
paste0("Date: ", Sys.time()),
"",
"INPUTS:",
paste0("  motif freq RDS: ", freq_rds),
paste0("  single-site meta CSV: ", meta_single_csv),
"",
"TOP SITES INCLUDED:",
paste0("  ", paste(top_sites, collapse = ", ")),
"",
"COHORT SIZES (single-site only):",
paste(apply(site_n, 1, function(x) paste0("  ", x[[1]], ": ", x[[2]])), collapse = "\n"),
"",
"MOTIF FILTER:",
"  ATGC-only (removed motifs with IUPAC/degenerate bases)",
"",
paste0("Motifs total (ATGC-only): ", n_distinct(df_site_top$end_motif)),
paste0("Site-exclusive motifs (present in exactly 1 top site): ", nrow(site_exclusive)),
paste0("Testable motifs (present in >=2 top sites): ", nrow(testable),
if (require_all_three_sites) " [require_all_three_sites=TRUE]" else ""),
paste0("Motifs tested with KW: ", nrow(res_final)),
paste0("Significant motifs (FDR<", fdr_cutoff, "): ", sum(res_final$p.adj < fdr_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE)),
"",
"OUTPUTS:",
paste0("  ", outdir)
), con = summary_txt)

message("Done. Outputs saved in: ", outdir)
```
